dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a distinctly falcate silhouette with the deepest part of the curve located in the lower third of the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a broad pixel radius at the highest point, lacking acute vertices.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at a steep slope of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of maximum longitudinal base width to vertical height from the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, white punctate markings and depigmented spots scattered across the lateral flank and fin surface; minor irregular notches visible on the lower trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Complex mottled pigmentation pattern consisting of dark grey patches superimposed on a medium grey background, particularly concentrated on the flank below the dorsal fin.
